project.title: MetricGuard: Trustworthy AI Analytics on IBM Db2
project.short_description: Natural-language analytics on IBM Db2 where the model only plans. Meta Muse Spark 1.3 (via LangChain) returns a typed plan; deterministic code compiles parameterized SQL from hash-locked Db2 metric definitions, runs it as a SELECT-only account, reconciles the numbers and writes an append-only Db2 audit record.

members.name: Jaehyup Shin
members.role: Solo developer: Db2 schema, backend, AI planner, frontend

ibm_db2.connector: ibm_db 3.3.0 (Python), called from FastAPI; LangChain is used only for the Meta model call
features_used: Relational tables with CHECK and composite foreign-key constraints
Least-privilege accounts (SELECT-only reader, INSERT+SELECT audit writer) proven by rejected writes

ai_models: Meta Muse Spark 1.3 (muse-spark-1.3, Meta Model API, reasoning_effort=low)
